title: AI Engineer
description: Nova Labs is building the next generation of AI-powered SaaS products and we need a talented AI Engineer to join our growing team. You will design, develop, and deploy AI models and agents that power our core product features. Working closely with product and engineering teams, you will own the full lifecycle of AI features from research to production. This is a remote-first role with a collaborative, async-friendly culture.
requirements: 3+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering
Strong proficiency in Python and FastAPI or similar frameworks
Experience with OpenAI API, LangChain, or similar LLM tooling
Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar)
Experience deploying models to production (Docker, AWS, or GCP)
Strong communication skills for remote collaboration
company_description: Nova Labs is a Series B AI startup building intelligent automation tools for modern enterprises. Founded in 2022, we have 80+ employees across 15 countries.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Velocity Labs is a fast-growing fintech startup looking for a Full Stack Developer to help build and scale our consumer-facing web platform. You will work across the entire stack — from crafting pixel-perfect React frontends to designing robust Python APIs. We value clean code, thoughtful architecture, and a product-first mindset. Our engineering team is fully remote across Europe and Asia.
requirements: 3+ years of full-stack development experience
Proficiency in React or Next.js and TypeScript
Strong backend skills in Python (FastAPI or Django)
Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases
Understanding of REST API design principles
Comfortable working in an agile, fast-paced environment
company_description: Velocity Labs is a UK-based fintech startup making personal finance smarter through AI-driven insights and automation. We are backed by top European VCs.

title: Backend Engineer
description: CoreStack is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to help architect and build the infrastructure powering our enterprise data platform. You will design highly scalable microservices, lead technical discussions, and mentor junior engineers. Our stack is primarily Python and Go, running on Kubernetes in GCP. We have a collaborative Berlin office with hybrid flexibility.
requirements: 5+ years of backend software engineering experience
Deep expertise in Python (FastAPI, Django, or Flask)
Experience with distributed systems and microservices architecture
Strong knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases
Familiarity with Kubernetes and Docker
Experience mentoring junior engineers
company_description: CoreStack is a Berlin-based enterprise software company building cloud-native data infrastructure for global enterprises. We are a team of 200+ engineers from 30 countries.

title: AI Agent Developer
description: AgentForge is at the forefront of agentic AI development. We are looking for an AI Agent Developer who is passionate about building autonomous AI systems that can reason, plan, and take actions. You will design and implement multi-agent workflows, tool integrations, and evaluation pipelines. This role is fully remote with a strong async culture and a focus on research-driven engineering.
requirements: 2+ years of experience building LLM-based applications or AI agents
Strong Python skills with experience using OpenAI SDK, LangChain, or CrewAI
Understanding of prompt engineering and chain-of-thought reasoning
Experience with tool/function calling in LLM APIs
Ability to design and evaluate agentic workflows
Interest in AI safety and reliable AI systems
company_description: AgentForge builds the developer platform for next-generation AI agents. Our tools are used by thousands of developers to build and deploy autonomous AI workflows at scale.

title: Python Developer
description: DataBridge is looking for a Python Developer to join our data engineering team. You will build data pipelines, automate workflows, and develop internal tools that power our analytics platform. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly in a supportive team environment. We offer mentorship, clear career progression, and the flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada.
requirements: 1+ years of Python development experience
Familiarity with data manipulation libraries (pandas, numpy)
Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases
Experience with Git and version control
Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn
Good written communication for async collaboration
company_description: DataBridge is a Canadian data intelligence company helping mid-market businesses make better decisions through automated analytics and reporting. Bootstrapped and profitable.

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Prism Digital is a leading digital product agency based in Karachi, working with clients across the US, UK, and Middle East. We are looking for a skilled Frontend Engineer to join our product team. You will build beautiful, fast, accessible web interfaces using React and Next.js. Our clients include funded startups and enterprise brands, so quality and attention to detail matter. Remote within Pakistan.
requirements: 2+ years of frontend development experience
Strong proficiency in React and JavaScript/TypeScript
Experience with Next.js and server-side rendering
Proficiency in Tailwind CSS or similar utility-first CSS frameworks
Understanding of web performance optimization
Experience with RESTful APIs and state management
company_description: Prism Digital is a Karachi-based digital agency delivering world-class web products for global clients. We have a team of 50+ designers and engineers.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Cognify Labs is an AI research company pioneering applied machine learning for healthcare diagnostics. We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of our predictive models and MLOps infrastructure. You will work closely with data scientists and medical experts to take models from research to reliable production systems. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of AI and healthcare.
requirements: 5+ years of machine learning engineering experience
Strong Python skills (PyTorch or TensorFlow)
Experience building and maintaining ML pipelines (MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar)
Understanding of model evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
Experience with cloud ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI)
Bonus: experience in healthcare or regulated industries

title: DevOps Engineer
description: CloudFirst is a cloud infrastructure company helping startups and scale-ups run reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure on AWS and GCP. We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our platform team, responsible for CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes cluster management, and infrastructure-as-code. You will work with a small, senior team and have real ownership over production systems that power dozens of client environments.
requirements: 3+ years of DevOps or infrastructure engineering experience
Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or self-hosted)
Proficiency in Terraform or Pulumi for infrastructure as code
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar)
Solid AWS or GCP skills with relevant certifications preferred
Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)

title: Software Engineer

title: LLM Engineer
description: MindBridge AI is building AI-native enterprise applications powered by large language models. You will work on RAG pipelines, prompt optimization, model evaluation, and integrating LLMs with business data sources. This is a hands-on engineering role at a company that treats AI as a core competency.
requirements: 2+ years of experience with LLM-based application development
Strong Python skills
Experience building RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines
Hands-on experience with OpenAI API, Anthropic, or Hugging Face
Understanding of embedding models and vector search
Experience with prompt engineering and LLM evaluation methodologies
company_description: MindBridge AI is a London-based AI company building enterprise LLM applications that transform how organizations work with knowledge and data. Backed by Tier 1 UK VCs.
